derivation: Replace Q (sextet 16) with Z (sextet 25), changing only the four unused low bits from zero to nine. RFC 4648 Section 3.5 defines canonical pad bits; the shared contract selects rejection. RFC 8941 Section 4.2.7 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8941.html#section-4.2.7) fails parsing when decoding fails.
